next_issue.title: feat(structures): 3D directrix spine & swept curved columns (IfcSectionedSpine)
next_issue.body:
### Overview
As part of debim v1.0.0 Wave 2 ("The Pure Algorithmic Architecture"), implement 3D curved structural ribs/columns following 3D spline directrix trajectories (such as the 28 curved steel columns of Museo Soumaya) that travel along the outer hyperbolic loft boundary.

### Tasks
1. In `src/debim/schema.py`: Support `structures.column_generator`:
   - `count: int` (e.g. 28 columns)
   - `distribution: Literal['RADIAL_ELLIPTIC', 'UNIFORM_PERIMETER']`
   - `profile: str` (e.g. 'CIRCULAR_HOLLOW_D600')
   - `trajectory: Literal['LOFT_SURFACE_ISOPARAMETRIC', 'DIRECTRIX_SPLINE']`
2. In `src/debim/compiler.py`:
   - Generate curved 3D column trajectories interpolating loft surface points at each storey.
   - Compile columns to IFC4 as segmented `IfcColumn` chains or `IfcSectionedSpine` geometry preserving structural continuity and connectivity to floor beams.
3. In `src/debim/qto.py`: Calculate total curved structural steel linear meters and weight based on the 3D arc lengths.
4. In `src/debim/viewer.py`: Render smooth 3D curved columns in WebGL viewer.
5. Unit tests in `tests/test_curved_spine_columns.py`.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Compiles 28 curved structural columns smoothly wrapped around hyperbolic lofts.
- Accurate QTO linear meter and steel tonnage calculation.
- `pytest tests/test_curved_spine_columns.py` passes 100%.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(facade): conformal hexagonal tessellation & high-performance IfcTriangulatedFaceSet export
next_issue.body:
### Overview
As part of debim v1.0.0 Wave 3 ("The Pure Algorithmic Architecture"), implement algorithmic surface discretization of double-curved facade lofts into thousands of hexagonal panels (Centroidal Voronoi / Hexagonal Tessellation like Museo Soumaya's 16,000 aluminum tiles) with ultra-lightweight IFC4 export.

### Tasks
1. In `src/debim/geometry/tessellation.py`: Implement conformal hexagonal grid generation on parametric loft surfaces:
   - `target_panel_size: float` (e.g. 0.55m diameter)
   - `joint_gap: float` (e.g. 0.02m reveal gap)
   - Fast UV-to-3D projection with constant planar hex tiles.
2. In `src/debim/compiler.py`: Compile tens of thousands of panels efficiently without memory bloat using:
   - Grouped `IfcCurtainWall` containing indexed `IfcTriangulatedFaceSet`.
   - Or instanced `IfcMappedItem` geometry to keep IFC file size under 5 MB for 16,000 panels.
3. In `src/debim/viewer.py`: Implement Three.js InstancedMesh rendering for 60 FPS real-time rendering in browser.
4. In `src/debim/qto.py`: Calculate panel counts, total facade surface area, and anodized aluminum BOQ quantities.
5. Unit tests in `tests/test_hexagonal_tessellation.py`.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Discretizes double-curved loft surface into hexagonal cladding tiles with uniform gaps.
- Compiles to lightweight IFC4 and renders smoothly in WebGL.
- `pytest tests/test_hexagonal_tessellation.py` passes 100%.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(benchmark): flagship Museo Soumaya benchmark project (examples/museo_soumaya/) & v1.0.0 GA validation
next_issue.body:
### Overview
As the crowning milestone of debim v1.0.0 Wave 4 (Final Milestone), integrate the entire Pure Algorithmic Architecture stack into the official flagship showcase: **Museo Soumaya** (Fernando Romero / Arup, Mexico City) — 7-storey asymmetric hyperbolic loft, 28 curved columns, and ~16,000 hexagonal aluminum panels, with live standards sync.

### Tasks
1. Author `examples/museo_soumaya/project.yaml` using the debim v1.0.0 algorithmic syntax.
2. Connect live standards (`PRIDA-TAKON/debim-standards`) for CGD v480 pricing, aluminum facade rates, and embodied carbon.
3. Provide end-to-end integration tests in `tests/test_museo_soumaya_benchmark.py`:
   - `debim validate examples/museo_soumaya/project.yaml` passes.
   - `debim qto examples/museo_soumaya/project.yaml` calculates correct surface area and steel tonnage.
   - `debim compile examples/museo_soumaya/project.yaml -o dist/soumaya.ifc` completes in < 10 seconds.
   - `debim view examples/museo_soumaya/project.yaml -e dist/soumaya.html` exports interactive 3D WebGL viewer.
4. Update documentation with visual preview in `docs/examples/museo_soumaya.md`.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Complete end-to-end execution of Museo Soumaya benchmark passes without errors.
- IFC4 model validates successfully under BuildingSMART standards.
- `pytest tests/test_museo_soumaya_benchmark.py` passes 100%.
next_issue.label: jules
